title: Hynek gave Spielberg alien drawings for Close Encounters
summary: Budd Hopkins tells of Hynek gave Spielberg alien drawings for Close Encounters, about late 1960s-1977 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: collection of drawings very similar to these that date from actually back into the late 60s and early 70s that Dr. Alan Heinik uh handed to Spielberg to use uh for his special effects.

plain: A UFO researcher and artist named Budd Hopkins says that J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer who advised the US Air Force on UFO reports, gave the filmmaker Steven Spielberg a set of drawings of aliens. According to Hopkins, the drawings went back to the late 1960s and early 1970s, Spielberg used them for the special effects in his 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind, and they look very much like drawings made by other people who say they met such beings, which would suggest the film's aliens came from real witness accounts.
